# PhysxVehicleTankDifferentialAPI

Differential of a wheeled tank vehicle, applied on the vehicle prim: which wheels form each track and which thrust control drives it, on top of the multi-wheel differential columns. Outside the differential parse the runtime only checks that the vehicle [prim](glossary.md#prim) lists it (or PhysxVehicleMultiWheelDifferentialAPI), to attach the parsed differential to the vehicle.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Requires on the same prim:** [`PhysxVehicleAPI`](PhysxVehicleAPI.md)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxVehicleMultiWheelDifferentialAPI`](PhysxVehicleMultiWheelDifferentialAPI.md):** The schema makes the multi-wheel differential a built-in of this API. The walkers parse a prim that lists this API as a tank differential only, reading the multi-wheel differential columns as part of it.
- **[`PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI`](PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI.md):** A tank controller requires this differential and a standard drive; the runtime also checks every wheelIndicesInTrackOrder entry against the wheel count.

## Notes

- The parser reads and validates physxVehicleTankDifferential:numberOfWheelsPerTrack, thrustIndexPerTrack, trackToWheelIndices and wheelIndicesInTrackOrder plus the physxVehicleMultiWheelDifferential columns, and the runtime applies their live changes. They are not described yet.
